title: Custard Egg Tart (Chinese-Style Egg Custard Tart)
description: A classic Chinese dessert featuring a rich egg custard filling in a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: Roll out the nutty pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Trim the edges of the dough to fit the pan.
In a small bowl, whisk together the rich egg custard, egg, and yolk.
Pour the egg mixture into the pastry shell.
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Continue baking the tart for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the center is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the tart chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of nutmeg if desired.
